correctness.rationale: Structural induction is complete. In a symmetric frame, every successor of a nonisolated world is itself nonisolated, so if \(\pi(A)=(a_i,a_n)\) then \(\pi(\Box A)=(1,a_n)\); implication acts coordinatewise. The four displayed formulas realize all four bit profiles, and a one-world empty frame plus a two-world symmetric edge separate every distinct pair. The frozen verifier was read; its exhaustive bounded semantics is corroborative only, not the infinite proof.

final_claim: Every variable-free formula of modal logic KB over symmetric Kripke frames is equivalent to exactly one of \(\bot\), \(\top\), \(\Box\bot\), or \(\neg\Box\bot\). Equivalently, its truth is completely determined by the two-bit profile at isolated and nonisolated worlds; validity in the variable-free fragment is linear-time, while the known one-variable fragment is PSPACE-complete.
limitations: Ordinary one-modal KB over nonempty symmetric frames only.
The exact-classification priority remains best-of-knowledge because older constant-formula literature is incompletely accessible.
